title: Child support and his only domestic problem
summary: He paid more than the court asked for a child from a relationship during the separation.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And, there was one other thing that was in an article and it dealt with legal support for a child in 1954?
Oh, yeah. That was a girlfriend I was going with.
Well, at the time when we were separated, then I met this other young lady, you know, and then we got to be very friendly.

You know, and then well, it's like some other people. We just happened to have had a child, and then I had to take care of the child. But, we was close. We didn't have no, I'm trying to see how, what caused that to come up because actually, there wasn't no fight between us, you know.
No, that's what I'm saying. It was just in, what was it? Jet? Or, one of the magazines. I didn't know, but it was just in the file.
Yeah. I think they changed the rules then cause I was giving it to her. Then, I think the Court wanted to take her, wanted to send the money directly to them.
And then, instead of me sending what they asked for, I sent them more. You know? I sent more money for them.

I think they wanted something like $20. What did I do? I sent $35 or $40, sometimes $50. You know, that's for each week. I did that. Take care of that. So, we never had no fights between us. She understood.
Yeah. Well, as we are dealing with Erskine Hawkins, the man, as opposed to the musician, have there been other domestic or other problems of that nature that have affected your career?
That's the only one I had problems with, problems of that nature.
And that was on account of, was during the time that I was separated from my wife. That's the only domestic
